title: V5 TUI: live % hint beside amount fields (F5 burn, F6 send)
brief: Owner UX: while typing amount in TUI modals, show immediately to the right of the input what % of the available limit that value represents. F5 burn marks field vs marks_available; F6 send amount field vs owner balance_pwm (raw). Update on every keystroke via existing modal re-render.

f5_burn.display: suffix on same Line as input, e.g. `  (42.5% of marks)` — hide or show em-dash when empty/unparseable/zero denominator

f6_send.denominator: owner balance_pwm raw at form open — add SendForm.balance_units: u128 populated in f6_build_send_form from selected AcctRow.balance_pwm (respect UNKNOWN sentinel as no hint)
f6_send.display: suffix e.g. `  (12.3% of balance)` using parse_decimal_pwm_units on current amount text

design.fee_field: optional same-line % of balance for fee if trivial; not required for PASS
design.stake_s_u: out of scope (F7 stake modal); note as follow-up if owner wants parity
design.helper: shared fn in pwm-tui (e.g. form_amount_hint.rs or send_form.rs): format_pct_of_limit(parsed: u128, limit: u128) -> Option<String>; use saturating math, 1 decimal for >=10% else 2 decimals, cap display at 100%+ with `100%+` when exceeds limit

acceptance_criteria: F5 render_burn_modal: marks amount line shows live % of marks_available while typing
F6 render_send_modal: amount line shows live % of owner balance while typing
f6_build_send_form / SendForm carry balance_units from selected owner row
Unit tests for pct formatter (empty input, partial parse fail, zero limit, 100%, >100%)
cargo test -p pwm-tui --lib; cargo test -p pwm-tui form_amount or send_form as applicable
cargo check -p pwm-tui; python scripts/check_entity_name_segments.py on touched files
notes: Owner request after marks observability slice. Render-only UX; no wire/protocol changes.
